preamble: Palatalization of the voiced alveolar fricative [z] to [zʲ]: the tongue body is raised toward the hard palate during the consonant, typically before front vowels or a palatal glide. It is phonemic in Russian and Bulgarian.

examples.note: Proto-Slavic consonants before front vowels became palatalized in East Slavic; the palatalized series is now phonemic in Russian.
Stressed yat *ě became [ʲa] before a hard syllable in Eastern Bulgarian, leaving the preceding consonant palatalized.
